citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4801.1. Clerk of courts fees (2023)
content:
(a) The fees to be charged and collected by the clerk of courts in counties of the
      second class shall be as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4802. Books of account to be kept; fees to be paid to county treasurer monthly
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4802. Books of account to be kept; fees to be paid to county treasurer monthly
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4802. Books of account to be kept; fees to be paid to county treasurer monthly (2023)
content:
(a) Each of said officers shall keep a special account book, the form of which shall
      be prescribed by the controller, in which entry shall be made of all the moneys received
      for fees and of all moneys earned and chargeable upon the county, specifying the day
      and date, the title of the case, if any, for what service, and from whom received.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4803. Penalty for receiving gratuities or percentages
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4803. Penalty for receiving gratuities or percentages
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4803. Penalty for receiving gratuities or percentages (2023)
content:
If any of the officers included in this subdivision shall receive or stipulate to
   receive from any deputy or clerk or from any person or persons awarded any contract
   for advertising or any other contract any sum or sums of money as percentage on the
   salaries of said deputy or clerk or on the amounts or profits of said contract, or
   any sum or sums of money whatsoever as compensation for making any of the said appointments
   or contracts, or shall neglect to render the accounts or to pay over the money received
   for fees as required by this subdivision,1or shall wilfully neglect to make any proper entry in the book or books required
   to be kept, or shall wilfully neglect to charge for any official services the fees
   allowed by law, or shall take to his own use any such fees, or fail to comply with
   any of the provisions of this subdivision, or neglect to discharge any of the duties
   herein imposed, the same shall be deemed a misdemeanor in office, and, in addition
   to the other penalties for such offenses, he shall, upon conviction thereof, refund
   the said sum or sums of money thus unlawfully received, and shall be deemed incapable
   of holding longer the said office.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVII. Employes' Retirement System›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4716. Contribution or retirement allowance not subject to levy, attachment or assignment; suspension of retirement allowances; ineligibility
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVII. Employes' Retirement System › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4716. Contribution or retirement allowance not subject to levy, attachment or assignment; suspension of retirement allowances; ineligibility
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4716. Contribution or retirement allowance not subject to levy, attachment or assignment; suspension of retirement allowances; ineligibility (2023)
content:
No contribution, retirement allowance or service increment shall be subject to levy,
   sale, execution, attachment, garnishment, or any other process whatsoever, and shall
   not be subject to assignment or transfer.  Said retirement allowance and service increment shall be exempt from any State tax
   or tax of any political subdivision.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4804. False swearing to county accounts, bills or transcripts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4804. False swearing to county accounts, bills or transcripts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4804. False swearing to county accounts, bills or transcripts (2023)
content:
Any officer included in this subdivision1or any other person who shall wilfully swear or affirm falsely as to the accuracy
   of any account, transcript or bill required in this subdivision, or in making any
   affidavit in reference thereto, shall be deemed guilty of perjury, and, upon conviction
   thereof, shall be liable to the punishment prescribed by law for perjury;  and any
   person who shall procure any other person to swear or affirm falsely in verifying
   any such account, transcript or bill, or in making any affidavit in reference thereto,
   shall be deemed guilty of subornation of perjury, and, upon conviction thereof, shall
   be liable to the punishment prescribed by law for that offense.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVII. Employes' Retirement System›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4712. Amount of retirement allowances
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVII. Employes' Retirement System › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4712. Amount of retirement allowances
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4712. Amount of retirement allowances (2023)
content:
(a)(1) For employes hired prior to the effective date of paragraph (2),1the retirement allowance paid under the provisions of this article shall equal fifty
         per centum of the amount which would constitute the average monthly compensation as
         received by the county employe during the highest twenty-four months of the last four
         (4) years of his employment or two years on a bi-weekly pay basis in which period
         of time the said county employe made monthly or bi-weekly contributions into the retirement
         fund prior to his or her retirement.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4801. Fees of salaried county officers to belong to county
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4801. Fees of salaried county officers to belong to county
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4801. Fees of salaried county officers to belong to county (2023)
content:
All fees limited and appointed by law to be received by any county officer, either
   elected or appointed, or which they shall legally be authorized, required or entitled
   to charge or receive, shall belong to the county.  Each of the said officers shall exact, collect and receive all such fees to and
   for the use of the county, except such taxes and fees as are levied by the Commonwealth,
   which shall be to and for the use of the Commonwealth.  None of said officers shall receive for his own use or for any use or purpose whatever,
   except for the use of the proper county or for the Commonwealth, as the case may be,
   any fees for any official services whatsoever.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4808. Payment of certain officers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4808. Payment of certain officers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4808. Payment of certain officers (2023)
content:
The county solicitor, county jailor, county commissioners, county controller, county
   engineer, county detectives, county treasurer, interpreter of courts, district attorney
   and his assistants shall severally be paid bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly, or quarterly,
   at the discretion of the county commissioners.  They shall be paid the full amount allowed them by law, but all fees and emoluments
   whatsoever that may accrue to any of them by virtue of his office shall be paid by
   him to the county treasurer as directed by law, and all other officers shall be paid
   the amounts assigned them only when the net receipts of their respective offices shall
   reach the amounts respectively fixed for them.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4807. Monthly returns to be made of taxes and fees due the commonwealth
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4807. Monthly returns to be made of taxes and fees due the commonwealth
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4807. Monthly returns to be made of taxes and fees due the commonwealth (2023)
content:
(a) At the same time that monthly returns are made, as required by section 1802 of
      this act,1of the fees received by said officers to and for the use of the proper county for
      the preceding month, each of said officers shall make a separate return, to the Department
      of Revenue, of all taxes or fees collected or earned for the Commonwealth by him,
      if any.  The amounts so returned by any of said officers, as received by him for the Commonwealth,
      shall be separately paid by him into the State Treasury through the Department of
      Revenue, quarterly, on the first Mondays of April, July, October and January, for
      which he shall take duplicate receipts.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4810. Salaries of county officers

content: The annual salaries of the following county officers shall be as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4806. Salaries payable from fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4806. Salaries payable from fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4806. Salaries payable from fees (2023)
content:
All salaries fixed by law, except as may be otherwise provided for herein, shall be
   paid from the amounts paid into the county treasury from the respective offices, after
   ascertaining and deducting the amount due the deputies and clerks in each office.  If there has not been a sum sufficient, from fees received and paid in or earned
   and due by the county for services rendered, to pay the full amount of the salary
   of any officer holding any of said offices, after deducting the amount due the deputies
   and clerks, such officer shall receive only such proportion of his salary as shall
   be equal to the aggregate of the net fees received and earned by him, as aforesaid,
   during his term of office during such month.  If the fees in any subsequent month or months shall exceed the amount of the expense
   and salary aforesaid for such month, the deficit of such salary for such preceding
   month shall be made up from such excess.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(b) Salary Board›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4821. Fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (b) Salary Board › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4821. Fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4821. Fees (2023)
content:
All county officers shall continue to charge and collect the fees, mileage and emoluments
   of office for their own use or for the use of the county, as provided by law, and
   where required by law, such fees, mileage and emoluments shall be paid to the county
   treasurer as and when required, and if no time of so paying be fixed as to any such
   fees, mileage or emoluments, then on or before the tenth day of each month.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(b) Salary Board›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4820.1. Insurance and other employe benefits
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (b) Salary Board › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4820.1. Insurance and other employe benefits
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4820.1. Insurance and other employe benefits (2023)
content:
In addition to any other authorized compensation, county commissioners and other county
   officers and their dependents shall be eligible for inclusion in group life, health,
   hospitalization, medical service and accident insurance plans or employe benefits,
   or payments made in lieu of such benefits, paid in whole or in part by the county,
   provided such plans, benefits or payments are offered generally to employes of the
   county.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4805. Officers subject to this subdivision to be paid salaries
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4805. Officers subject to this subdivision to be paid salaries
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4805. Officers subject to this subdivision to be paid salaries (2023)
content:
All county officers to which this subdivision applies, whether elected by the people
   or appointed according to law, and their several deputies and clerks, shall be paid
   for their services by fixed and specific salaries, which shall be a charge upon the
   treasury of the county to which each shall respectively belong, to the extent, except
   as hereinafter provided, of the fees collected and paid in by each officer respectively,
   or earned, where fees are chargeable upon the county treasury, and said salaries shall
   be paid semi-monthly or bi-weekly during the month in which the services were rendered,
   at the discretion of the county commissioners.  No warrant shall be drawn for the payment of any of said officer, his deputies or
   clerks who shall not have filed the receipt and transcript for that month provided
   for in this subdivision.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(b) Salary Board›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4820. Salaries and compensation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (b) Salary Board › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4820. Salaries and compensation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4820. Salaries and compensation (2023)
content:
The salaries and compensation of county officers shall be as now or hereafter fixed
   by law.  The salaries and compensation of all appointed officers and employes who are paid
   from the county treasury shall be fixed by the salary board created by this act1for such purposes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(a) Fees of County Officers›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4809. Salaries in lieu of fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (a) Fees of County Officers › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4809. Salaries in lieu of fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4809. Salaries in lieu of fees (2023)
content:
Except to the extent this section may be inconsistent with any other express provision
   of this act,1the salaries fixed and provided by law for county officers shall be in lieu of all
   or any moneys, fees, perquisites, or mileage expenses, and other allowances received
   or allowed to any such officer, and all such moneys, fees, perquisites, or mileage
   expenses, and other allowances, not governed by the aforesaid exceptions, shall belong
   to the county and shall be paid into the county treasury, except where required to
   be paid to the Commonwealth in the manner provided by this subdivision2for fees.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(b) Salary Board›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4822. Salary boards created
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (b) Salary Board › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4822. Salary boards created
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4822. Salary boards created (2023)
content:
There is hereby created in the county a salary board, which shall consist of the three
   individual members of the board of county commissioners and the county controller.  The chairman of the board of county commissioners shall be chairman of the salary
   board and the county controller secretary thereof.  The board shall meet and organize on the first Monday of January of each year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(b) Salary Board›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4824. Revisions of salary schedules
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (b) Salary Board › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4824. Revisions of salary schedules
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4824. Revisions of salary schedules (2023)
content:
At each annual meeting, the board shall revise the salary schedule so far as it shall
   deem such action necessary.  From time to time between annual meetings, whenever required by any judge, county
   officer or executive head of any separate board, commission or division, the number
   or compensation of whose deputies, assistants, clerks and employes is sought to be
   fixed, the board shall meet and consider and shall fix and determine the same.  All salaries fixed under the provisions of this act1shall be paid out of the county treasury.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 16 P.S. Counties›Chapter 2. Second Class County Code›Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board›(b) Salary Board›PA ST 16 P.S. § 4823. Number and compensation of officers, deputies, assistants, clerks and employes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 16 P.S. Counties › Chapter 2. Second Class County Code › Article XVIII. Fees of Salaried County Officers; Salary Board › (b) Salary Board › PA ST 16 P.S. § 4823. Number and compensation of officers, deputies, assistants, clerks and employes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 16 P.S. § 4823. Number and compensation of officers, deputies, assistants, clerks and employes (2023)
content:
The board, subject to limitations imposed by law, shall fix the compensation of all
   appointed county officers, and the number and compensation of all deputies, assistants,
   clerks and other persons whose compensation is paid out of the county treasury, and
   of all court criers, tipstaves and other court employes, and of all officers, clerks,
   stenographers and employes appointed by the judges of any court and who are paid from
   the county treasury.
